shots.detail_en: CH draws a ketchup K-line across the closed tea-restaurant table as three glass cups clink together in the corner booth.
shots.sub: 作战室，今晚开张。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: MANCANG drags over a fourth stool while RED spreads a stack of hand-copied ledger pages under the neon-lit rain.
shots.sub: 作战室第一条——本教主坐镇，忠心必须全仓！／第二条：账页不准沾油。
shots.speaker: MANCANG+RED

shots.detail_en: MANCANG slams his pager onto the table center as the screen lights up in a chain.
shots.sub: 情报网开张——全大厅的嘴，都长在我 BP 机上！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's pager screen scrolls relayed messages from the retail crowd in the hall.
RED presses counter-transaction pages under a desk lamp and runs her fingertip down the columns of numbers.
shots.sub: 我在柜台坐了三年——人嘴会骗，账目不会。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: RED and CH lock eyes across the booth as the division of labor settles between them.
shots.sub: 我管钱往哪儿流。／我管它为什么流。
shots.speaker: RED+CH

shots.detail_en: CH lines up three glasses with a fork—one for the counter, one for the hall, one for the screen.
shots.sub: 三只眼睛——柜台一只，大厅一只，屏一只。缺一只，我们就是瞎子。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CH, RED and MANCANG run a four-cut montage of eavesdropping in the crowd, ledger-copying at the counter, screen-watching and night note-matching at the booth.
shots.sub: 白天，三只眼睛同时睁开。
shots.speaker: VO

shots.detail_en: The big board's Lianhua Hotel line plunges at the open as the whole trading hall erupts.
shots.sub: 联华酒店出事了！要跌穿了！
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's pager explodes with alerts as the crowd swallows him whole.
shots.sub: 消息来了——西厅在哭，东厅在骂！
shots.speaker: MANCANG
shots.fx: BP 机连环哔+人群逼近

shots.detail_en: Silhouetted retail investors panic in split frames—clutching slips, spinning in circles, stampeding the counter.
shots.sub: 割啊！再不跑就真没了！
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: CH stands motionless, his eyes sweeping the volume column as the noise cuts out.
shots.sub: 跌得这么齐——像有人排队往下走。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: RED passes a note over the counter and their fingertips touch on the corner of the page.
shots.sub: 割肉单是约好的——同一分钟开始。／恐慌不会约时间。
shots.speaker: RED+CH

shots.detail_en: MANCANG squeezes back into the booth, sweating, pouring out everything he overheard.
shots.sub: 话不一样，调一模一样——像一个人写的台词！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: CH presses three notes side by side on the table, matching one identical timestamp.
shots.sub: 消息同一天进的货——这不是恐慌，是采购。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CH smiles slowly in front of the churning green board as RED and MANCANG both turn to look.
shots.sub: 他们收的不是股——是人心。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CH, RED and MANCANG nod at one another at the same time for the first time.
shots.sub: 那我们怎么办？／他们要人心，我们还他们冷静。
shots.speaker: RED+CH

shots.detail_en: RED stays alone after hours at the counter, calculator and wall clock ticking in unison.
shots.sub: 让我看看——你是谁。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: RED's red pen traces a column of orders spaced exactly one minute apart.
shots.sub: 手会抖，机器不会——这是同一只手。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: RED freezes as she pulls a 1993 ledger page from the deep drawer—the two rhythms identical.
shots.sub: 这个节奏……十年前，也有人这么敲过。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: CH folds three notes into his father's notebook on the rooftop and holds the repaired pocket watch to his ear.
shots.sub: 爸，队成形了。可对面那只手……我摸到过。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Black end card with next-episode caption.
shots.sub: 十年前敲出这节奏的那只手——腕上，缠着一串佛珠。
shots.speaker: VO
shots.card: 十年前敲出这节奏的那只手——腕上，缠着一串佛珠。
